Your demo file is not with us, so the import reads any CSV or Excel file: you map its columns the first time, and it remembers the mapping per source. A dry run shows the counts first (new, changed, refused); only then do you import. A car is recognised by HSN, TSN and variant; cars typed by hand or from a Gutachten are never overwritten. No bolt circle needed. Please send us your demo file so we can check the mapping against it.

Solved differently: an article is now built from blocks in any order — section, image, table, quote. An image is uploaded right in the article, stored in our own storage, and needs a description for screen readers. A table is typed cell by cell, with header cells, 2 to 6 columns. There is deliberately no free HTML: it could put someone else's code on the site. The check before publishing names anything missing at the place it is missing.

Checked, including with a forged signature: an order from the shop opens only with the link from its e-mail, in the browser that placed it, or in the customer account. The link is signed and valid for twelve months; after that, the page sends a new one to the order's e-mail address on request. Someone who knows only the number sees the same page as for a number that does not exist. Only the preview's example orders open by number: they belong to no real customer and are removed with the demo data.
